page.description: Value is used to get the items on a specific page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.). Maximum `page` value is `100`.

sort.description: Sorting. (e.g. `price_low`, `price_high`, `best_seller`, `best_match`, `rating_high`, `new`). **Note:** `best_seller`, `rating_high`, and `new` are not supported for `walmart.com.mx`.

facet.description: Items filtering based on their attributes. The structure is a list of `key:value` pairs separated by `||`. The key and value are separated by `:`

nd_en.description: Show results with NextDay delivery only. Set to `true` to enable or `false` (default) to disable. **Note:** not supported for `walmart.com.mx`.

query.description: The search query. You can use anything that you would use in a regular Walmart search. Either a `query` or a `cat_id` parameter is required.

cat_id.description: Category on Walmart Search. (e.g. `0` (default) is all departments, `976759_976787` is 'Cookies', etc.). Either a `query` or a `cat_id` parameter is required. **Note:** not supported for `walmart.com.mx`.

device.description: The device to use to get the results. It can be set to `desktop` (default) to use a regular browser, `tablet` to use a tablet browser (currently using iPads), or `mobile` to use a mobile browser.

spelling.description: Activate spelling fix. `true` (default) includes spelling fix, `false` searches without spelling fix.

store_id.description: Store ID to filter the products by the specific store only. Head to the Walmart Stores Locations for a full list of supported stores. It's possible for the product pricing to differ between stores.

max_price.description: Upper bound of price range query.

min_price.description: Lower bound of price range query.

soft_sort.description: Enables sort by relevance. Walmart is by default showing results sorted by relevance and using the `sort` option. Set to `false` to disable sort by Relevance. **Note:** not supported for `walmart.com.mx`.

walmart_domain.description: The Walmart domain to use. It defaults to `walmart.com`. Head to the Walmart Stores for a full list of supported stores per domain.

include_filters.description: Include `filters` to the JSON response. Set to `true` to enable or `false` to disable (default).

json_restrictor.description: The fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details.

free_quota.note: Shared across all free-quota APIs, resets 00:00 UTC.

readme:
# Walmart Search

Search Walmart products by keyword with price, rating, reviews, seller and fulfillment badges, plus sorting, price filters and pagination.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/walmart/search" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "laptop"}'
```

This API runs asynchronously. The call returns a task `id` with status `pending`; poll `GET https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/run/{id}` until `status` is `completed` and read the result from `outputs[0].data`.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |

| `device` | string/number/boolean | No | The device to use to get the results. It can be set to `desktop` (default) to use a regular browser, `tablet` to use a tablet browser (currently using iPads), or `mobile` to use a mobile browser. |
| `facet` | string/number/boolean | No | Items filtering based on their attributes. The structure is a list of `key:value` pairs separated by `\|\|`. The key and value are separated by `:` |
| `include_filters` | any | No | Include `filters` to the JSON response. Set to `true` to enable or `false` to disable (default). |
| `json_restrictor` | string/number/boolean | No | The fields you want to include in the output, reducing payload size for faster response. See the JSON Restrictor documentation for more details. |
| `max_price` | string/number/boolean | No | Upper bound of price range query. |
| `min_price` | string/number/boolean | No | Lower bound of price range query. |
| `nd_en` | any | No | Show results with NextDay delivery only. Set to `true` to enable or `false` (default) to disable. **Note:** not supported for `walmart.com.mx`. |
| `page` | string/number/boolean | No | Value is used to get the items on a specific page. (e.g., `1` (default) is the first page of results, `2` is the 2nd page of results, `3` is the 3rd page of results, etc.). Maximum `page` value is `10… |
| `soft_sort` | string/number/boolean | No | Enables sort by relevance. Walmart is by default showing results sorted by relevance and using the `sort` option. Set to `false` to disable sort by Relevance. **Note:** not supported for `walmart.com.… |
| `sort` | string/number/boolean | No | Sorting. (e.g. `price_low`, `price_high`, `best_seller`, `best_match`, `rating_high`, `new`). **Note:** `best_seller`, `rating_high`, and `new` are not supported for `walmart.com.mx`. |
| `spelling` | any | No | Activate spelling fix. `true` (default) includes spelling fix, `false` searches without spelling fix. |
| `store_id` | string/number/boolean | No | Store ID to filter the products by the specific store only. Head to the Walmart Stores Locations for a full list of supported stores. It's possible for the product pricing to differ between stores. |
| `walmart_domain` | string/number/boolean | No | The Walmart domain to use. It defaults to `walmart.com`. Head to the Walmart Stores for a full list of supported stores per domain. |

Flat price per call. Failed calls are not charged.
